activity.role: General and commander of the Cristero forces
activity.notes: The National League for the Defense of Religious Liberty recruited former general Enrique Gorostieta in July 1927 to coordinate and professionalize the Cristero armed struggle. He became the movement's principal military commander and was killed on 2 June 1929, shortly before the negotiated end of the Cristero War. ATLAS models him as active in the Cristero movement rather than as a ruler of a sovereign 'Cristero state'.

sources.title: History of the Cristiada — University of Texas at Austin
sources.citation_text: The University of Texas history states that in July 1927 the Liga recruited former general Enrique Gorostieta to coordinate the Cristero effort.
